description.zh: 拓展色系数量，取值范围[1, 8], 默认：1
description.en: The number of extended color schemes. Valid values: 1 to 8. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 色板拓色,Top主色列表，颜色值定义ARGB,如：0A0B0C，数组大小[1, 7]
description.en: The list of top dominant colors for color palette recoloring. The color value is defined in ARGB format, such as 0A0B0C. The array size ranges from 1 to 7.

description.zh: 拓色模式,默认AUTO,取值范围[AUTO:自动拓色, TEMPLATE:色板拓色, REF_PIC:参考图拓色]
description.en:
The recoloring mode. Default value: AUTO. Valid values:
- AUTO: automatic recoloring.
- TEMPLATE: color palette recoloring.
- REF_PIC: reference image recoloring.
The URL of the reference image for reference image recoloring.

description.zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K。
description.en: The URL of the original image. The URL must be publicly accessible and can be up to 8 KB in length.

descriptions.zh:
示例结果：

![](http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor.png)



入参示例：
```
自动拓色：
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "mode": "AUTO",
  "colorCount": 3
}

参考图拓色：
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "refUrl": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-refurl-src.png",
  "mode": "REF_PIC"
}

色板拓色
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "colorTemplate": [ 
    { "color": "056A6B"}, 
    { "color": "FF0000"}, 
    { "color": "00FF00"}, 
    { "color": "0000FF"}
  ],
  "mode": "TEMPLATE"
}
```
descriptions.en:
Sample result:

![](http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor.png).

Sample request parameters:
```
Automatic recoloring:
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "mode": "AUTO",
  "colorCount": 3
}.

Reference image recoloring:
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "refUrl": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-refurl-src.png",
  "mode": "REF_PIC"
}.

Color palette recoloring:
{
  "url": "http://vigen-invi-cdn.alibaba.com/aliyun-doc/pop/images/recolor-1-src.png",
  "colorTemplate": [ 
    { "color": "056A6B"}, 
    { "color": "FF0000"}, 
    { "color": "00FF00"}, 
    { "color": "0000FF"}
  ],
  "mode": "TEMPLATE"
}
```.
